comment: Real tests, real tags, a marker spelling the module never declared. filament-ide-rs: 1,292 such symbols, 0 bound, reported as 555/2389 (23%) with nothing saying so. #256: and it must name ONE of them — `src/lib.rs:5`, the annotation line, not the `fn` line, because a marker that failed to match is written where the annotation is and that is what the reader edits. The diagnostic named the LANGUAGE and nothing else, so a reader with 1,292 unbound symbols was told to search Rust.
